title: Quick Simmered Middle Eastern Tomatoes Tagine
description: A fresh and fluffy Middle Eastern dish featuring diced tomatoes, perfect for a quick fix. Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a delightful meal.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Fresh or canned, whichever suits your taste.

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin adds depth to this dish.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a smoky flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for added flavor.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large comal over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Garnish with a dollop of yogurt or a sprinkle of sumac for added flavor.
